name: pickup_airdrop_spawn_ref_init_global_from_carrier_node_name
description: PickupAirdropSpawnRef::InitGlobalFromCarrierNodeName allocates the global airdrop spawn ref and discards it when the carrier or healthy attach node is missing.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; Binary Ninja shows VC5 exception-registration and operator-new cleanup scaffolding, so byte matching should be handled with the coherent Pickup source-cluster pass rather than this isolated wrapper.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x438a90 validates allocation of 0x14 bytes, call to PickupAirdropSpawnRef::InitNodesFromCarrierNodeName, assignment to g_Pickup_GlobalAirdropSpawnRef, validation of carrierNode and dropAttachNode, operator delete on failure, and clearing of the global pointer.
The native smoke verifies the missing-carrier cleanup path and the successful allocation path with carrierNode and healthy dropAttachNode populated, followed by ShutdownGlobal cleanup.
